2608.07006.title: Does More Retrieved Evidence Help Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Diffusion Language Models?
2608.07006.paper_summary: Visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) commonly expands the retrieved evidence set to improve answer-page coverage, implicitly assuming that all available evidence should be passed to the generator. We show that this assumption does not hold for diffusion language models (DLMs): retrieving more pages increases answer-page recall, whereas unconditionally passing all retrieved pages to the generator often reduces answer accuracy, primarily because of semantic conflict. A latent-source analysis explains this mismatch through source-coherence loss in parallel denoising, where position-wise proposals can combine incompatible visual sources into unsupported answers. We further find that such interference is already visible in the first-step answer-block distribution, making it possible to assess evidence before decoding. To preserve retrieval coverage while limiting harmful visual exposure, we propose the Entropy-Based Candidate Filter (ECF), a training-free evidence-admission framework. To reduce irrelevant content within individual candidates, ECF constructs multi-granularity evidence units; to identify beneficial additional evidence, it uses blank-controlled block confidence and retrieval rank to determine whether and which candidate should enter the final context. Across three multimodal DLMs and five visual QA benchmarks, ECF improves answer accuracy by 2.62 percentage points on average over the strongest fixed top-$k$ input and, with LLaDA2.0-Uni, by 2.37 percentage points on average over the best competing training-free result for each dataset. These results show that broader retrieval benefits visual DLM-RAG through selective evidence admission rather than unconditional evidence expansion. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/wjkuser/ECF.
2608.07006.paper_summary_zh: 視覺檢索增強生成（RAG）通常擴展檢索到的證據集，以改善答案頁面的覆蓋率，隱含地假設所有可用的證據都應該傳遞給生成器。我們顯示這一假設對於擴散語言模型（DLMs）並不成立：檢索更多頁面增加了答案頁面的召回率，而無條件地將所有檢索到的頁面傳遞給生成器往往會降低答案的準確性，主要是因為語義衝突。潛在來源分析通過平行去噪中的來源一致性損失解釋了這一不匹配，其中逐位提議可以將不相容的視覺來源組合成不支持的答案。我們進一步發現，這種干擾在第一步答案區塊分佈中已經可見，使得在解碼之前評估證據成為可能。為了保留檢索覆蓋率同時限制有害的視覺暴露，我們提出了基於熵的候選過濾器（ECF），這是一個無需訓練的證據接納框架。為了減少個別候選中的不相關內容，ECF 構建了多粒度的證據單元；為了識別有益的額外證據，它使用空白控制的區塊置信度和檢索排名來決定是否以及哪些候選應該進入最終上下文。在三個多模態 DLMs 和五個視覺 QA 基準上，ECF 在最強的固定 top-$k$ 輸入上平均提高了 2.62 個百分點的答案準確性，並且在 LLaDA2.0-Uni 上，對於每個數據集的最佳競爭無訓練結果平均提高了 2.37 個百分點。這些結果顯示，更廣泛的檢索通過選擇性證據接納而非無條件證據擴展使視覺 DLM-RAG 受益。代碼可在 https://github.com/wjkuser/ECF 上公開獲得。
